info.title: Permguard Authority Plane API
info.description: The Authority Plane (`2-security/8`): `/authority/v1` and `permguard.authority.v1` on the Authority Plane's own listener, one facade behind both. Service accounts with access keys and scopes, the token endpoint, the keys and the status lists every Plane verifies tokens with. Every administration route decides by the caller's access token, its scopes on `plane/authority`; the keys, the lists and the metadata are open to every caller.

get.description: RFC 8414, open to every caller: the issuer, the token endpoint, the JWKS and what the endpoint accepts.

post.description: RFC 6749 `client_credentials` with the profile of RFC 9068: the access key and its secret key prove a service account, and the token carries its scopes, narrowed to `scope` when asked, signed by `authority.tokens`, with its entry in a status list. `Authorization: Basic` is read here and nowhere else; every answer is `Cache-Control: no-store`. The secret key travels only over TLS outside `development`.

requestBody.description: `grant_type=client_credentials`, the client's proof and, optionally, the scope asked and the lifetime. The proof is `Authorization: Basic` (`client_secret_basic`), or `client_id` and `client_secret` in the form (`client_secret_post`), never both.

client_id.description: The access key, beside `client_secret`, or the Basic user.

scope.description: The operations asked, space separated, narrowing the account's; the account's whole when absent.

requested_lifetime.description: Seconds, within the profile's maximum; an hour when absent.

401.description: `invalid_client`: the access key and secret key prove no live account. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="permguard"`.

429.description: `slow_down`: too many requests for the key or the source; `Retry-After` says when.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable`: no signing key, or the registry cannot record the token.

get.description: Open to every caller: the `authority.tokens` public keys as a JWKS, what access tokens and status lists are verified with; the current keys and those retiring while they overlap.
Open to every caller: the id of every list a live token may name, so a Plane fetches each.
Open to every caller: the signed `statuslist+jwt` itself, a fresh one once the list changed or half its `ttl` elapsed.

404.description: No list of that id is held (`not_found`).

get.description: Under `tokens.read` on `plane/authority`. Never a token: each by its `jti`, its account, key, scopes, times and status.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Only the tokens of this account.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only the tokens in this status: `valid`, `invalid` or `suspended`.

400.description: The body is not the request's shape, a value is invalid (`invalid_argument`), or the request id is absent (`request_id_required`).

401.description: No usable credential: nobody, or a token refused. Carries `WWW-Authenticate`, `Bearer realm="permguard", error="invalid_token"` when a bearer token was refused.

403.description: A token without `tokens.read` on `plane/authority`. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="permguard", error="insufficient_scope"`.

post.description: Under `tokens.revoke` on `plane/authority`, or by the token's own bearer: `INVALID` in its list, at once on this Host and on each Plane once it holds the list. Answers the token revoked.
